levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: Four branches end before «كلهم عن ابن شهاب»: that writes Ibn Shihab once for all of them, so he is the shared tail
«بإسناد مالك» points to Malik's chain, which the text does not write here: a back reference
«كلاهما عن ابن جريج» does not say which pair it covers; read as Abu Asim, then Ibn Jurayj, then Ziyad, following «أخبرني زياد»; the reading of this pair is uncertain
«إلا في حديث مالك وفي حديث يونس وزياد» and «نحو حديثه» are wording differences, left out
